title: MIME types describe files
summary: A MIME type tells the browser what kind of response it is receiving. Apache uses configured mappings and modules for common file types.
introduction: A MIME type tells the browser what kind of response it is receiving. Apache uses configured mappings and modules for common file types. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
